Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses MAJOR TERMS AND CONDITIONS SCOPE OF JOB: ============ CAMC FOR GCXGC-TOFMS & FID

VENDOR SCOPE ============= 1. Under the CAMC, Vendor has to provide preventive maintenance as well as breakdown mainten ance to keep the GCXGC-TOFMS & FID in good working condition. 2. Preventive maintenance: Vendor has to provide two PM visits per year on dates mutually conv enient to each other. 3. Preventive maintenance has to be done according to the instrument checklist, and the report ha s to be submitted along with the service report. 4. Breakdown maintenance: Vendor has to provide unlimited breakdown visit per year as a co mplimentary and no payment shall be made by HPCL towards BD visit. The vendor has to attend breakdown emergency within 72 hours after receiving the breakdown information. The vendor has to rectify the problem and put the equipment back in working condition. 5. The Spare parts supply will be under the scope of the vendor for the entire equipment. 6. Payment will be made on a visit basis, subject to the completion of all the planned activities for that particular period. 7. The vendor needs to raise an invoice after every visit during the CAMC period 8. The amount payable for the above services will be on a physical visit basis to R&D, and after co mpletion of the visit and submission of the invoice along with the service report. For detailed scope of job refer technical specification document attached to this tender. (Buyer Ad ded Bid Specific ATC Document) JOB TO COMPLETE | JOB TO COMMENCE ================================= The vendor has to attend breakdown emergency within 72 hours after receiving the breakdown inf ormation. Vendor has to provide two PM visits per year on dates mutually convenient to each other.
